certifications: PCAP - Certified Associate in Python Programming

beginner.summary: For developers who know basic Python (functions, classes, pip) and want to build and ship a complete web application. Covers the browser, HTTP and JSON, a FastAPI backend with Pydantic, PostgreSQL and SQL, SQLAlchemy 2.0 and Alembic, a React and TypeScript client built with Vite, password hashing and token login, protected routes, pytest and Vitest, Dockerfiles and Docker Compose, and a support-desk ticketing capstone that runs from one command.
prerequisites: Writes Python functions, classes and modules and installs packages with pip
Knows basic HTML and JavaScript syntax well enough to read a small script
Has a laptop with rights to install Python 3.12 or later, Node.js LTS, Git, Docker Desktop or Docker Engine, and an editor such as Visual Studio Code
outcomes: Explain how a request travels from a React page through a FastAPI route to PostgreSQL and back as JSON
Build a typed REST API with FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.0 and Alembic migrations on PostgreSQL
Build a React and TypeScript client that lists, creates and edits data and protects pages behind login
Test both tiers and run the whole stack locally with Docker Compose
